extDescription.message: Use DWG Viewer to open a DWG file in Chrome, view DXF online, toggle layers and save the view to PDF. Nothing is uploaded.

startDrop.message: Drop a DWG or DXF file here

privacyLocal.message: Drawings are rendered on this computer.

rangeLine.message: Opens DWG files from AutoCAD $1 to $2, and DXF files.

errCantReadBody.message: $1 is not a DWG or DXF drawing, or the file is damaged.

errCantReadHint.message: If it opens in your CAD program, save it again and try here.

errVersionKnownBody.message: $1 was saved in AutoCAD $2 ($3). DWG Viewer opens DWG files from AutoCAD $4 to $5.

errVersionUnknownBody.message: $1 was saved in a DWG version DWG Viewer doesn’t know ($2). DWG Viewer opens DWG files from AutoCAD $3 to $4.

errVersionHint.message: Open it in a CAD program, save it as DWG 2018 or DXF, and drop it here again.

errTooLargeTitle.message: This drawing is too large to open here

errTooLargeHint.message: Open it in a CAD program, or save only the part you need as a separate file.

partialRest.message: The rest of the drawing is shown.

emptyNoObjects.message: No visible objects in this drawing

fontNote.message: Text is drawn with a system font and may look different from your CAD program.

tipLink1.message: Tip: click a .dwg or .dxf link on any site and the drawing opens here.

tipLink2.message: Or right-click the link and choose Open in DWG Viewer.

settingsToggleHint.message: When on, clicking a link to a .dwg or .dxf file opens it in DWG Viewer. When off, the file downloads as usual.

settingsNote.message: Right-click a link and choose Open in DWG Viewer to open it here either way.

noticeText.message: Links to .dwg and .dxf files now open in DWG Viewer.

errLinkTitle.message: Couldn’t get the drawing from this link

errLinkAuthWhy.message: The site may need you to sign in.

errLinkHint.message: Download it the usual way, then drop the file here.

errLinkSizeBody.message: $1 is $2. DWG Viewer opens files from links up to $3.
